metadata.title: Manga Gallery
metadata.subtitle: A curated exhibition of cover art from the Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation, featuring the 2019 series illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke and the 2016 series illustrated by Mani.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 1 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for the first volume of the 2019 manga adaptation, illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke. It features a soft, dreamy aesthetic that captures the atmospheric tone of the original story, with Adachi and Shimamura sharing a quiet moment together.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 2 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 2's cover introduces the full cast of the main group, showing the growing dynamics between the characters as the story expands beyond the central duo. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 3 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The third volume cover features a poignant composition, emphasizing the emotional distance and connection between the two leads. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 4 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 4's cover shows the characters in a brighter, more serene setting, reflecting the quiet moments of happiness in their relationship. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 5 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for Volume 5 features a beautiful, melancholic composition that hints at the emotional complexities explored in this volume. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 6 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 6's cover continues Yuzuhara Moke's signature style, using soft lighting and gentle expressions to convey the deepening bond between the characters.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 7 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for Volume 7 features a particularly striking composition, with the characters framed against a warm, inviting background. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 8 Cover (2019 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for Volume 8 features a particularly striking composition, with the characters framed against a warm, inviting background. Illustrated by Yuzuhara Moke.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 1 Cover (2016 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for the first volume of the original 2016 manga adaptation, illustrated by Mani. This edition features a distinctive art style that captures the early essence of the series with a slightly different aesthetic compared to the later adaptation.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 2 Cover (2016 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 2's cover from the 2016 series shows the expanded cast in Mani's unique style, with a more playful and energetic composition compared to the 2019 series.

artworks.title: Manga Volume 3 Cover (2016 Series)
artworks.curatorNote: The final volume of the 2016 series, featuring Adachi and Shimamura in a heartfelt moment. Mani's art style gives the characters a distinct look that differs from the later Yuzuhara Moke adaptation.

Yuzuhara Moke.bio: Illustrator of the 2019 Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation.

Mani.bio: Illustrator of the 2016 Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation.

Japanese Manga Cover.description: Cover illustrations for the Japanese editions of the Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation, including both the 2016 series by Mani and the 2019 series by Yuzuhara Moke, published by Kadokawa.
